title: Backpropagation Through Time to Update Neural Network Input, Hidden and Output Weights
content: The tutorial introduces the packpropagation algorithm for calculating many-to-many Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) input, hidden and output weights coefficients recurrently. It is proven chain rules expressions for calculating Loss Gradients, that use for backpropagation,  over each weight. The numerical example of tht backpropagation for many-to-many RNN is a guide for weights initialization and one step in recurrent process of computing new weights values.
